name: Zechariah
overview: Zechariah was a male official serving under King Jehoshaphat, known for being sent out to teach the people as part of the king's efforts to instruct Israel in the law. The Scripture does not provide information about his tribal affiliation or family background. His role highlights his involvement in religious education during Jehoshaphat's reign.
namesAndTitles: The name Zechariah means 'YHWH remembers,' reflecting a theologically rich Hebrew proper name. This meaning underscores God's faithfulness and remembrance, though the name itself was not given directly by God according to the record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Zechariah beyond his official capacity under Jehoshaphat. There are no additional relational details provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zechariah's significance lies in his role as an emissary of King Jehoshaphat, tasked with teaching the people of Judah. This responsibility situates him within the broader biblical theme of upholding and disseminating God's law, contributing to the spiritual renewal efforts during Jehoshaphat's reign. His service exemplifies faithful leadership in religious instruction.
